propositions: Frontier exclusion-list treatment arm (B) failed to reduce re-search overlap rate by the required >=30% on any corpus ticket; instead increased overlap +78% on ticket 45c1 and +60% on ticket 8d74 relative to control

Data-shaped frontier block rendered inert by untrusted fence design and paradoxically increased measured overlap by signposting prior evidence locations, causing model to immediately re-read files listed as already-searched

Cache seeding mechanism (verdict-based skipping) already removes dominant redundancy of re-proving credited criteria; frontier block cannot suppress re-grounding of unproven criteria within untrusted context

Production telemetry does not carry argument-level tool-call transcripts (paths, patterns, result classification) needed to empirically validate frontier utility; PoC captured these via harness-side monkeypatch
